findings.evidence: if any registered tool's input schema contains a recursive #/$defs/ $ref (e.g. a self-referential pydantic model parameter), _short_type follows it with no cycle guard and would raise RecursionError at request time; check whether any catalogue tool has a recursive parameter type
findings.title: Unbounded recursion on self-referential $ref

findings.evidence: anyOf/oneOf branches are joined with ' | ' with no cap, unlike the 8-value enum cap with ellipsis, so a wide union produces a long type string; only matters for pathological schemas beyond the measured catalogue
findings.title: Union short types are not length-capped

findings.evidence: uses transform._mcp._list_tools(), and the alias-precedence semantics (a real registered name, even a family-hidden one, blocks alias resolution) depend on that call returning unfiltered registered names; verify this holds across fastmcp upgrades
findings.title: Exact-name path relies on FastMCP private internals

findings.evidence: if the base BM25SearchTransform also routes native (non-compact) on-request rendering through search_result_serializer, native requests would return compact summaries contrary to the class docstring; the pre-existing suite passing suggests the native path is separate, but confirm in BM25SearchTransf
findings.title: Serializer applies to every render path of this transform

findings.evidence: schema['enum'] == [] returns '' from _short_type; such a schema is invalid per JSON Schema, so cosmetic only
findings.title: Empty enum yields empty type string

findings.evidence: the size-bound test builds its old-format baseline via the private server._list_tools() API, coupling the test to fastmcp internals; acceptable in tests but a maintenance note
findings.title: Size test uses private server._list_tools()
